name: Jason Joseph
summary: IT operations and solo consulting, with work in workflow improvement, client-engagement systems, and custom Zoho solutions for small and mid-sized businesses.

civic-awareness-project-know-your-vote: District lookup works from the full address rather than a ZIP code. It started on Google geocoding and moved to a self-hosted Pelias instance.

It builds a corpus from Firecrawl and publisher sitemaps, streams stories to candidate pages, and characterizes coverage with a model. A confidence threshold and outlet-lean review sit on top of that step.
chazak-studio-management: Research agents search for open calls and grants. SQL filters check each artist's eligibility.
A person approves each opportunity before it reaches anyone. Every artist then gets a feed of opportunities they can apply to.
output-engine: It runs 15 LLM stages from intake to delivery. Each stage writes a versioned record that has to be approved before the next one runs.
Image models would not hold a room steady, so a Blender previs layer was added: shots are planned in Blender and animated with Kling, and a mannequin carries a seven-joint anatomy check.
The engine has been used for real work, including brand art for Know Your Vote that was placed into that site, and multi-angle product shots.
